item.title: ‘Tinubu runs Kabiyesi govt, Peter Obi will do better’ – Abaribe
item.description: Abia South Senator, Enyinnaya Abaribe, has accused President Bola Tinubu of incompetence in running the government, stressing that former Labour Party’s presidential candidate, Peter Obi will do better. item.title: Nnamdi Kanu’s trial ‘tough’ – Lawyer Ejimakor
item.description: Legal consultant to Nnamdi Kanu, leader of the Indigenous People of Biafra, IPOB, Aloy Ejimakor, has disclosed that the trial of the Biafra agitator was “tough”. Ejimakor, who was Kanu’s lead counsel for one year, disclosed this while recounting his stint as the head of the IPOB leader’s legal team. Kanu was rearrested in Kenya in 2021 and subjected to extraordinary rendition back to Nigeria. item.title: We withdrew formation of private Hisbah for sake of peace in Kano – Ganduje
